title: Error
description: Canonical error taxonomy (docs/03). The error code is the stable contract; the message is human-facing and is never parsed by machines.

message.description: Human-facing. Never contains secrets, credentials, tokens, or raw venue payloads.

details.description: Structured, machine-readable context. Must be safe to log and safe to return to an authorized operator.

retryable.description: Whether an identical retry could succeed without operator action. FALSE for every risk-increasing command where the prior outcome is unknown: a retry that could increase exposure is never marked retryable (docs/01 §10.3).

x-code-semantics.VALIDATION_ERROR: Request violated a contract. No state change.
x-code-semantics.AUTHENTICATION_ERROR: Caller identity could not be established. Deny.
x-code-semantics.AUTHORIZATION_ERROR: Caller identity established but not permitted. Deny. Policy cannot approve or override financial risk (ADR-018).
x-code-semantics.CONFLICT: Optimistic concurrency or uniqueness violation. Last-write-wins is prohibited for authoritative state (docs/01 §8).
x-code-semantics.RISK_REJECTED: The deterministic Risk Engine vetoed the command. Authoritative and final: AI, UI, and venue response cannot override it (docs/25 §3.1).
x-code-semantics.DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE: A required dependency failed. Fails closed for risk-increasing work.
x-code-semantics.TIMEOUT_UNKNOWN: An external outcome could not be established. The outcome is UNKNOWN, never assumed to be a rejection or a fill. Triggers reconciliation (docs/01 §6, docs/25 §3.3).
x-code-semantics.DATA_STALE: Required market data is stale or contradictory. The feed is marked unhealthy and dependent commands are denied.
x-code-semantics.RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED: Authoritative state cannot be established. Reconciliation or recovery workflow has started.
x-code-semantics.INTERNAL_ERROR: Unexpected failure. Detail is logged with correlation_id; the message never carries sensitive data.

examples.message: Order rejected by pre-trade risk policy.
Venue submission outcome unknown; reconciliation required.
